question: What do the currently indexed primary audits say about Soroban authorization recursion or reentrancy risk?

golden.answer: Search the live audit index, then cite the versioned Veridise primary report. V2 labels the investigated authorization-recursion item **V-SOR-VUL-002** with severity Critical, but its valid-vulnerability summary counts zero Critical issues. V2 already judges the item invalid inline because error propagation makes work linear in trackers and constructing many trackers is costly. V2.1 relocates the same write-up to Appendix A.2.2 as **V-SOR-APP-VUL-003**. Do not present it as an active confirmed vulnerability or as generic EVM reentrancy. Scout currently exact-misses the real V2.1 appendix identifier, so verify that identifier against the primary report instead of treating the miss as real-world absence.
